self_review: Challenged every Y for an actual production caller, including transitive QTS GGML backends & legal-ui. Reclassified models as M: studio.models.install calls rightkit-models while asr_provision independently owns an active pinned Whisper artifact lifecycle. Retained HTTP as Y because all found direct app routes terminate in rightkit-http through GenRight's policy wrapper, which adds product policy but no competing transport. Reclassified compose as NA: Motion permits only one HTML/WebView layer, outside rightkit-compose's typed visual/media model. Confirmed rightkit-asr exposes WhisperCpp FFI & rightkit-audio exposes typed FFmpeg primitives; retained both N for unshared active GenRight routes. Kept stale local patches as delivery_flags, not M; kept Swift rows NA because GenRight is Tauri/Rust desktop.
